name: Reslice parcellation to match input anatomy
summary: Reslices a volumetric parcellation onto the voxel grid of a T1-weighted image with FreeSurfer mri_vol2vol (header registration, nearest-neighbour interpolation), keeping its label file.
description: Resamples parc.nii.gz to the voxel size and spacing of the T1w image with mri_vol2vol --regheader and nearest-neighbour interpolation, and copies label.json unchanged. Use it when a parcellation is already in the same space as the T1w image but on a different voxel grid; it does not perform registration.

inputs.description: T1-weighted image whose voxel grid is the reslicing target.
inputs.requirements: Must already be aligned with the parcellation; only header geometry is used.

outputs.description: Parcellation resliced to the T1w voxel grid, with the original label.json.

citations.text: Dale AM, Fischl B, Sereno MI. Cortical surface-based analysis. I. Segmentation and surface reconstruction. NeuroImage 9:179-194 (1999).
